structure: One fixed iid mixture law generates both measurements for each woman. CHNS Hb-band frequencies, Hb moments, ferritin log moments and depletion probabilities determine the marginals. Bounded-beta Hb distributions and monotone two-slope Gaussian transformations for log ferritin match the supplied summaries in population. A Gaussian copula supplies within-band dependence. Finite-sample counts and moments fluctuate naturally.

revision.decision: Retain the sealed scientific specification and generator unchanged.
revision.reason: The supplied generated-only report shows close agreement with all checked A-table summaries. The discrepancies are compatible with Monte Carlo variation and provide no concrete reason to revise the marginal construction. No new statistic identifies within-band dependence, so the report does not justify tuning the copula or the unreported Spearman correlation.

parameter_provenance.source: Supplied CHNS A-only supplement, Tables 1 and 2
parameter_provenance.population: Evidence-community linked complete-case women aged 18–49, regardless of pregnancy or inflammation; one measurement pair per woman
parameter_provenance.measurement: Central whole-blood Hb in g/dL and uncorrected serum ferritin in micrograms/L
parameter_provenance.parameters: Band weights 206:619:298, depleted counts 123:148:59, and thresholds Hb <12 and ferritin <15
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Aggregate counts are treated as fixed population anchors; sampling and community-transport uncertainty are not propagated.

parameter_provenance.population: Same CHNS evidence cohort, not independent evidence from Table 1
parameter_provenance.parameters: All band-specific Hb means and sample SDs and ferritin geometric means and geometric SDs in model_spec
parameter_provenance.derivation: Hb beta parameters follow from reported moments and assumed supports. Ferritin slopes follow from each band's depletion probability, mean log ferritin and SD log ferritin, using SD(log ferritin) = log(geometric SD).
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Rounded sample summaries are used as population targets, not enforced on generated finite samples.

parameter_provenance.source: Zhu et al., 2010, DOI 10.1024/0300-9831/a000014, Methods pp.145–146 and Tables III and V
parameter_provenance.population: Separate June 2004 rural Hebei sample of 1,671 selected nonpregnant, nonlactating, parous IUD users; not CHNS
parameter_provenance.measurement: Hemocue Hb in g/L and plasma ferritin in micrograms/L
parameter_provenance.evidence: Table III reports increasing ferritin geometric means across Hb strata: 1.3, 5.9 and 22.3 micrograms/L. Table V reports adjusted anemia OR 6.448, 95% CI 4.827–8.615, for ferritin <15.
parameter_provenance.adjustment: Table III is descriptive by Hb stratum; Table V includes age, BMI, education, folate deficiency and B12 deficiency.
parameter_provenance.use: Qualitative support for positive dependence and a stronger iron-related gradient at low Hb. These findings do not identify within-CHNS-band correlations. The adjusted OR and Hebei marginal distributions are not imposed on CHNS.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: The reported OR interval describes that source analysis, not uncertainty in the nominated copula correlations.

parameter_provenance.parameters: Within-band latent Gaussian correlations 0.30, 0.15 and 0.10; Hb beta supports 0–12, 12–14 and 14–24 g/dL; two-slope log-ferritin shapes
parameter_provenance.rationale: Allow modest positive residual dependence, strongest in the anemia band, while preserving the closer CHNS aggregates.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Neither these correlations nor the tail shapes and support endpoints are identified by the supplied evidence.

requested_estimands.name: Crude unweighted odds ratio
requested_estimands.definition: Odds of Hb <12 g/dL among women with ferritin <15 micrograms/L divided by those odds among other women, using the same generated people.
requested_estimands.model_anchor: The transported population table implies (123 × 710)/(83 × 207) = approximately 5.083. This is derived from A-only evidence, not an estimate from unseen communities.

requested_estimands.name: Unweighted Spearman rank correlation
requested_estimands.definition: Correlation between ranks of continuous, uncorrected Hb and ferritin across the same generated women.
requested_estimands.model_anchor: Determined by the observed between-band differences plus assumed within-band copula dependence; not identified by the supplied summaries.

limitations: The most consequential remaining assumption is the within-band dependence: the nominated copula correlations directly affect Spearman correlation but are not measured in the supplied evidence.
Transporting the A-community joint distribution to other communities under the same CHNS design is unverified; identical sampling design does not ensure identical biomarker distributions.
Hb beta shapes, the 24 g/dL upper support and ferritin tail shapes remain unverified. This is a descriptive joint law, not a causal model of iron treatment.
Pregnancy, inflammation, age composition, assay effects and community clustering are not modeled separately. Ferritin remains uncorrected as requested.

The supplied checks assess reproduction of fitted A summaries, not target validity or unreported within-band association. Repeated seeds capture individual sampling variation under fixed parameters, not evidence or structural uncertainty.

checks_actually_performed.result: Table 1 totals 1,123 women, including 206 with low Hb and 330 with low ferritin. Table 2 has the same total; its nonanemic depleted counts sum to 148 + 59 = 207.
